translations.web: Yes, he scoffs at kings, and princes are a derision to him. He laughs at every stronghold, for he builds up an earthen ramp, and takes it.
translations.bsb: They scoff at kings and make rulers an object of scorn. They laugh at every fortress and build up siege ramps to seize it.

translations.asv: Yea, he scoffeth at kings, and princes are a derision unto him; he derideth every stronghold; for he heapeth up dust, and taketh it.
